name: David S. West
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Marietta, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: David S. West is the managing partner at David West & Associates in Marietta, Georgia. A top-rated attorney with more than 26 years of total legal experience, Mr. West focuses his practice on criminal law and appeals. He represents clients throughout the state of Georgia with criminal law matters, and also represents clients with federal crime matters throughout the nation. Mr. West provides knowledgeable counsel and support to clients in criminal law matters involving any of the following:

A fierce and tireless lawyer, Mr. West is known for his zealous advocacy and firm commitment to his clients. He is a dedicated and tenacious litigator, helping his clients with their goals as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible. Mr. West has taken on many complex and prominent cases and has been featured inthe media as well.

Prior to starting his own law firm, Mr. West served as senior associate in another law firm in Georgia. Mr. West graduated from Berry College, majoring in political science, and was on the dean’s list. He earned his Juris Doctor from Georgia State University College of Law.

He is a member of the State Bar of Georgia and is admitted to practice in the U.S. District Court for the Northern and Middle Districts of Georgia, the Georgia Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court of Georgia. Active in the legal community, Mr. West is a member of the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws and the Cobb County Bar Association.

Having received many accolades for his work, Mr. West was awarded the Businessman of the Year title by the Business Advisory Council. He is actively involved in pro bono work and was a member of the 1000 Lawyers for Justice.
